record_scope_reconstruction: Cross-border rail freight on the Khasan–Tumangang Friendship Bridge. The road link proposed later, Khasan station and Tumangang yard are not alternative sites for this phase.

source_checks.finding: Far East Railways statement describes first resumed freight train through Khasan–Tumangang, with horses and planned medicine containers.
Satellite evidence independently identifies the 800-m railway bridge and distinguishes Khasan station two kilometres away; it does not reveal shipment purpose.

sites.name: Khasan–Tumangang Korea–Russia rail Friendship Bridge
sites.coordinate_method: Mean of unique vertices in fresh OSM named feature outline
sites.precision: Approximate crossing area, about 100 m; not the historical barrier footprint
sites.evidence_note: OSM named Friendship Bridge outline; satellite-observation article identifies this 800 m bridge as the railway link between Tumangang and Khasan, not the stations two kilometres away.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Cross-border rail freight on the Khasan–Tumangang Friendship Bridge. The road link proposed later, Khasan station and Tumangang yard are not alternative sites for this phase.

date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Freight onset remains month precision; February 3 is the passenger suspension date. November 1 is authority-reported first freight passage, not independently observed imagery; November 4 imagery is later corroboration. Passenger service excluded.

independence_statement: Pass B reconstruction from original-source retrievals and coordinate evidence; no pass A files or judgments consulted.
